overview:
Veronica Escobar seeks another term in a heavily Democratic El Paso-based district that favored Democrats by about 11 points on the partisan baseline. She is an established incumbent who has raised roughly $860,000, while Republican Adam Bauman reports no fundraising or outside support. No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for the race.

Prediction markets give Escobar about a 97% chance of winning, consistent with the fundamentals. The expected margin is around 21 points, with uncertainty near 8 points reflecting the absence of polling. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
